This query joins all Montgomery County census tracts (fw_pg.tracts) with EPA ECHO facility counts per tract (fw_pg.tract_counts, filtered by run_id and source) and CDC PLACES adult asthma prevalence data (session.fw_7b915b_m2_cdc). It computes EPA facilities per 1,000 residents using tract population, retains the adult population denominator (totalpop18plus), and outputs the paired tract-level rates needed for correlation. It uses a windowed CORR and COUNT(*) to provide the overall correlation coefficient and paired tract count, excluding tracts missing either measure, and orders by the EPA rate descending with tract name as tiebreaker.
sql:
SELECT 
  t.geoid,
  t.name,
  CAST(c.n AS DOUBLE) AS epa_facility_count,
  CAST(ct.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS total_population,
  (CAST(c.n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(ct.totalpopulation, 0) * 1000) AS epa_facilities_per_1000_residents,
  ct.casthma_crudeprev AS adult_asthma_prevalence,
  ct.totalpop18plus AS adult_population,
  CORR((CAST(c.n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(ct.totalpopulation, 0) * 1000), ct.casthma_crudeprev) OVER () AS correlation_coefficient,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts c 
  ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  AND c.run_id = 'r_20261026_7b915b'
  AND c.source = 'm1_cdc'
  AND c.grp = 'all'
LEFT JOIN session.fw_7b915b_m2_cdc ct 
  ON t.geoid = ct.tractfips
WHERE ct.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
  AND c.n IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_residents NULLS LAST, t.name
LIMIT 200
